race.title: Paul Fergusons Jumpers To Follow EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Dual-bumper winner GOVERNORS ROCK was found out in better company at Cheltenham last time, but this looks a good opportunity for him to resume winning ways. Moscow Star was much improved from hurdling debut when runner-up at Sedgefield last month and can give the selection most to think about, ahead of Jaunty Trooper , who has shown some promise in bumpers and has a fine jumping pedigree. GOVERNORS ROCK (IRE) MOSCOW STAR (FR) JAUNTY TROOPER
race.bettingForecast: Governors Rock (10/11), Moscow Star (4/1), Jaunty Trooper (6/1), Robin Blue Breast (8/1), Thetype Istitle (8/1), Valenciaga (25/1), Dressed Overall (33/1), Unbelievable Jeff (33/1), Maria's Joy (66/1), Jersey Tex (66/1), Sir Vinnie Kent (66/1), Bonnie Lazarevic (66/1)
